metaTitle: Certxa vs GlossGenius — Salon Software Comparison (2026)
metaDescription: Comparing Certxa and GlossGenius for nail salons, hair salons, and barbershops? See how Certxa's waitlist, revenue intelligence, built-in POS, and AI receptionist stack up.
heroHeadline: More than booking. A complete business platform.
heroSubhead: GlossGenius is a solid booking tool for solo stylists. Certxa is built for the full operation — walk-ins, waitlist, team payroll, revenue intelligence, and an AI receptionist — all in one platform, with no long-term contracts.
targetBusinesses: nail salons, hair salons, barbershops, spas, and massage studios
competitorSummary: GlossGenius is a booking and payment platform popular with independent stylists and solo beauty professionals. It offers a clean booking experience and card processing, but is primarily designed for single-provider businesses.
certxaSummary: Certxa is built for multi-staff beauty businesses — nail salons, hair salons, barbershops, spas, and massage studios. It covers the full operation: online booking, walk-in management, waitlist, self check-in kiosk, POS, team payroll, loyalty programs, revenue intelligence, and an AI receptionist.

differentiators.title: Waitlist management
differentiators.certxa: Live digital waitlist captures every walk-in. When a slot opens, the next client is auto-texted and given a one-tap confirmation window.
differentiators.competitor: No built-in waitlist management for walk-in businesses.

differentiators.title: Revenue intelligence
differentiators.certxa: Automatically detects client drift, identifies dead time slots, scores no-show risk, and sends re-engagement texts — without any manual work.
differentiators.competitor: Basic reporting. No proactive revenue recovery or client drift detection.

differentiators.title: Self check-in kiosk
differentiators.certxa: Tablet kiosk lets clients check in, pick their service, and join the queue — in English, Spanish, Vietnamese, Chinese, and Korean.
differentiators.competitor: No self check-in kiosk for walk-in or appointment-based businesses.

differentiators.title: AI receptionist
differentiators.certxa: Autumn AI answers calls 24/7, books appointments, and handles rescheduling against your real-time availability.
differentiators.competitor: No AI receptionist or automated phone answering.

differentiators.title: Team payroll
differentiators.certxa: Commission rates per staff member, tips tracked separately, pay periods, earnings statements, and printed paychecks — all built in.
differentiators.competitor: Limited to solo providers. No built-in team payroll or commission tracking for multi-staff businesses.

differentiators.title: Turn rotation
differentiators.certxa: Automatic walk-in assignment to staff based on rules you set. Live turn board shows who is next, busy, or on break.
differentiators.competitor: No turn rotation system for walk-in queue management.

faq.question: Is Certxa better than GlossGenius for nail salons?
faq.answer: For nail salons with walk-in traffic, multiple staff members, and a need for turn rotation and waitlist management, Certxa is a significantly more complete platform. GlossGenius is better suited to solo stylists who primarily take appointments.

faq.question: Can I switch from GlossGenius to Certxa?
faq.answer: Yes. Certxa's onboarding team can help you migrate your client list and service menu. The 60-day free trial lets you run both in parallel before committing.

faq.question: Does Certxa work for hair salons, not just nail salons?
faq.answer: Yes. Certxa is built for nail salons, hair salons, barbershops, spas, massage studios, hair removal studios, and braid and weave salons. Every feature adapts to the services your business offers.
